name: Pseudonism
source:
You play as Mallory, a teen living in a typical dystopian world where the government controls everything and everyone is miserable. Things take a turn,for better or for worse, taking you by surprise.

[From [url=https://eggsandghostt.itch.io/pseudonism]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演马洛里，一个生活在典型的反乌托邦世界的青少年，政府控制着一切，每个人都很痛苦。事情发生了转变，无论好坏，都让你措手不及。

[来自[url=https://eggsandghostt.itch.io/pseudonism]itch.io[/url]]
